title: Stepladder 1:1 cadence notes (scratch)
content:
Context: quick sketch for weekly 1:1 with Maya (report). Goal is to keep this short — three focus buckets: operational signals, career/growth, blockers + support. Use as live scratchpad during meeting, convert to Actions afterwards.

Meeting meta
- When: 30m weekly, prefer Tues 10:30am PT.
- Tone: coaching-first, problem-solving, concrete next steps.
- Desired outcome: unblock current sprint work, agree on 2-week experiment for latency root-cause, sync on promotion timeline and next mentoring match.

Agenda (30m)
1) Quick sync (5m)
   - How are you feeling this week? energy, bandwidth, risk? (open)
   - Any immediate time off / calendar conflicts?

2) Signals & Ops (10m)
   - Latency spike from Friday evening — p95 up 120ms on model-x in eu-west-1. My initial note: likely batching change + kernel fallback. Ask: did you see any retraining or model config change?
   - Metrics to check live: p50/p95 (last 24h), QPS, batching rate, number of kernel fallbacks.
   - Quick checklist to run in meeting if needed:
       * grep logs for "kernel-fallback" between 2027-06-11 18:00-22:00
       * check autoscaler events (k8s events) for node churn
       * review PR #482 (serving-runtime) for recent changes to batching policy
   - Ownership ask: Maya to own triage tomorrow morning and report back by 11:00am PT.

3) Project & roadmap blockers (7m)
   - Dedicated capacity rollout: staging load tests failing on memory usage for seq-len=2048. Is the checkpointing experiment in PR branch?
   - Ask: do you need a pairing session with infra (Tom) to adjust gc/alloc flags?
   - If blocked: escalate to me and I’ll pull Tom in same day.

4) Career / growth (6m)
   - Promotion timeline: confirm draft of impact memo due EOW Friday. Discuss bullet points to add:
       * Ownership: led kernel selection tuning across model-x, reduced p95 by 18% in Q1
       * Impact: shipped autoscaler fix that reduced cold-starts in dedicated by 35%
   - Coaching: want to pair on cross-team influence — propose meeting with product-hosted-api PM next Wed (ask Maya if she’s comfortable).

5) AOB / wrap (2m)
   - Mentoring: check in on mentorship match (Amaya) progress — pair session scheduled?
   - Follow-ups and confirm actions

During-meeting quick script/questions (for me)
- Start: "What’s the one thing I can help remove today?"
- If stuck on implementation: ask to show a console/log snippet (2–3 mins) and decide next step (pair / ticket / escalate).
- If overloaded: triage list and re-prioritize with me.

Notes (scratch, to be filled during meeting)
- Mood: Maya says "frustrated / focused" — flagged big TODO: memory leak in seq-len tests.
- Observations: PR #482 may have introduced a conservative fallback path — need to confirm commit hash and revert candidate.
- Action: Maya will run selective revert in a canary host tonight and report results.

Actions (post-meeting, populate as items finish)
- [ ] Maya: triage latency spike, collect logs and produce short root-cause hypothesis (due 2027-06-15 11:00am PT).
- [ ] Oliver: ping Tom (infra) and schedule 30m pairing if triage shows allocator pressure (due 2027-06-15 EOD).
- [ ] Maya: draft impact memo bullets for promotion; share with Oliver for review (due 2027-06-18).
- [ ] Maya + Amaya: mentoring sync — confirm first 1:1 and set goals (due 2027-06-21).
- [ ] Maya: run canary revert test on model-x host and post results in #serving-runtime (due tonight).

Unresolved questions / follow-ups to track
- Did a config rollout happen Friday 18:00-19:00? (Ops)
- Any customer incidents correlated to spike? (CS)
- If kernel fallback is root cause, what's safe revert path without harming throughput? (Tech)

Reference snippets I want to paste into tickets / Slack (short)
- "Observed p95 increase +120ms on model-x in eu-west-1 (2027-06-11 18:00-22:00). Suspect batching policy change in PR #482 — triage running. @Tom PTAL if node churn shows up in k8s events."

Prep checklist (before meeting)
- [ ] skim PR #482 diff (focus on batching policy changes)
- [ ] open logs for eu-west-1 host ids: rtd-host-11, rtd-host-13
- [ ] pull p95/p50 chart for last 7 days into meeting window

Notes to self (post-meeting update template)
- Summary: short 1–2 lines describing outcome.
- Decisions: what we agreed (e.g., run canary revert, pair with infra).
- Owners & deadlines: list items and due dates.
- Postmortem? decide later if impact > outage threshold.

Tone reminders for me
- Keep suggestions as hypotheses, not directives.
- Use "what do you need from me" vs. "you should".
- Celebrate small wins: if canary shows improvement, call it out in next squad sync.

End of scratchpad. Convert to final action items and update ticket(s) after meeting.
